req.prompt:
Hosts sometimes swap two bookings' tables. Add a SwapTables command in a new file src/booking/commands/swap_tables.rs, with the repository support it needs in src/booking/ports/booking_repository/ (trait and both adapters).

Keep cargo test and cargo clippy (-D warnings) passing. Do not run anything; just edit. No new comments. Reply with one line saying what you changed.

result: I added a `SwapTables` command in `src/booking/commands/swap_tables.rs` (registered in `commands/mod.rs`). It needs two new `BookingRepository` methods, `booking(id)` and `update(booking)`, which I implemented in both the in-memory and file adapters. I also added unit tests for the command and a contract test for the new methods. I haven't run `cargo test`, `cargo clippy` or `cargo fmt`, so none of it is checked. One long line in the file adapter's `update` is probably not rustfmt-formatted.
